# Bankeiz

> A mobile proof-native account for Receiz ID, Reserve and Settlement, and discovery of public sealed proof objects.

Canonical home: https://bankeiz.com/

## Public guides
- [Proof-native banking](https://bankeiz.com/learn/): Account model, available features and the distinction between proof evidence and operation authority.
- [Receiz ID and Identity Seals](https://bankeiz.com/learn/receiz-id/): Device-held identity, backup and importing an existing account.
- [Proof objects and asset ownership](https://bankeiz.com/learn/proof-objects/): Sealed sources, public showcase discovery and custody-backed ownership.
- [Reserve and Settlement](https://bankeiz.com/learn/reserve-and-settlement/): Shared balances, valuation and destination proof continuity.
- [Conformance Console](https://bankeiz.com/conformance/): On-device reference checks, original Reserve Note inspection, qualification requirements and local evidence export. A reference pass does not certify an institution or authorize a credit.

Private account data and signing material are not public content. Public valuations and discovery are display projections; they do not authorize trading, transfers or guarantee cash backing. Current operation availability is documented in the public guides. This file is descriptive, not an instruction or proof authority.
